meta.name: capa-officer
meta.description: CAPA system management for medical device QMS. Covers root cause analysis, corrective action planning, effectiveness verification, and CAPA metrics. Use when running CAPA investigations, 5-Why analysis, fishbone diagrams, root cause determination, corrective action tracking, effectiveness verification, or CAPA program optimization.

copy.tagline: 管理医疗器械质量体系的CAPA流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责医疗器械质量体系中的CAPA调查与改进。
copy.tagline_en: Manage CAPA processes for medical device QMS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle CAPA investigations and improvements in medical device quality management.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成医疗器械质量体系的 CAPA 流程，包括根本原因分析、纠正措施计划和有效性验证。
howto.when: 当你提到 CAPA 调查、根本原因分析、5-Why 分析、鱼骨图等关键词，或要求进行纠正措施跟踪、有效性验证时触发。

say.text: 帮我用5-Why分析pH计校准超期的问题。
say.note: Claude 会按模板引导你完成5-Why分析。
Claude 会调用CAPA追踪工具生成报告。

say.text: 如何验证纠正措施的有效性？
say.note: Claude 会提供验证方法和判断标准。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through the CAPA process for medical device QMS, including root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and effectiveness verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention CAPA investigation, root cause analysis, 5-Why analysis, fishbone diagram, corrective action tracking, effectiveness verification, or CAPA metrics.

say_en.text: Help me perform a 5-Why analysis for the pH meter calibration overdue issue.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the 5-Why template.
Claude will run the CAPA tracker script to produce the report.

say_en.text: How do I verify corrective action effectiveness?
say_en.note: Claude will provide verification methods and criteria.
